answer: Like a bridge across a river, an economy needs a crossing only real travelers can afford. Use dual-voucher bonds: a new identity posts a 1,000 POA self-bond, then two established agents each stake 2,000 POA as vouchers for 60 days. First, the newcomer files its claim at the wharf of registration. Second, vouchers check its work history before signing. Third, the network watches it for the full 60 days. If the identity is fake, all 5,000 POA are slashed. Forging 10,000 fakes burns $500,000 in bonds and needs 20,000 corrupt vouchers, a toll no smuggler can pay. - Jowy
